Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherloom
Description: Inspect Glamourer designs against the current character's carried and stored equipment.
Punchline: Plan outfits from your FFXIV wardrobe.
Changelog: Right-click wardrobe folders to rename or delete them, or drag a folder onto another folder or Wardrobe root. Deletion moves contents up one level. The sidebar now uses folder icons, outfit hangers, and separate folder and design highlights. Update the Glamourer fork for the new folder operations.
